description: Get GeoNames country facts — ISO alpha-2, alpha-3, and numeric codes, FIPS code, geonameId, capital, population, area in km², continent, languages, currency, postal-code format, and mainland bounding box — for the countries named, a continent, or all 250. The geonameId anchors geonames_get_children (a country's first-level divisions) and geonames_get_hierarchy. The full table is fetched once a day (1 GeoNames credit) and cached.

continent.description: Keep only countries on this continent: AF Africa, AN Antarctica, AS Asia, EU Europe, NA North America, OC Oceania, SA South America. Case-insensitive.

countries.description: Countries to return by ISO 3166-1 code: alpha-2 (US), alpha-3 (USA), or three-digit numeric (840), up to 50, as a list or a comma-separated string. Case-insensitive; UK is accepted for GB. Match country names with nameContains instead.

items.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, alpha-3, or three-digit numeric country code.

geonamesUsername.description: Your own GeoNames username, spent only when the country table is not already cached, so the call uses that account's credit instead of the server's. The account needs free web services enabled on its geonames.org account page.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return, 1 to 250. Default 50.

nameContains.description: Keep only countries whose English name contains every word of this text as a substring (niger also matches Nigeria), ignoring case, accents, and punctuation.

offset.description: Entries to skip before the first one returned, for paging. Default 0.

name: geonames_get_countries

countries.description: Countries on this page, in GeoNames order (by alpha-2 code).

areaInSqKm.description: Area in square kilometres. Absent where GeoNames gives none.

boundingBox.description: Bounding box of the country's mainland.

capital.description: Capital city name. Absent where GeoNames gives none.

continentCode.description: Continent code: AF, AN, AS, EU, NA, OC, or SA.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Absent where GeoNames gives none.

fipsCode.description: FIPS 10-4 country code. Absent where GeoNames gives none.

geonameId.description: The country's GeoNames feature id: pass it to geonames_get_children for its first-level divisions, or to geonames_get_place.

isoNumeric.description: ISO 3166-1 numeric code. Absent where ISO assigns none (Kosovo) or GeoNames gives none.

languages.description: Languages spoken, most used first, as GeoNames lists them.

items.description: A language tag such as en-US or haw.

population.description: Population as GeoNames records it. Absent where GeoNames gives none.

postalCodeFormat.description: Postal-code pattern (# a digit, @ a letter). Absent for countries without postal codes.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `username_required`: Neither geonamesUsername nor the server's GEONAMES_USERNAME supplies a GeoNames account. `caller_account_rejected`: GeoNames rejected the caller-supplied geonamesUsername (unknown user, or free web services not enabled). `server_account_rejected`: GeoNames rejected the server's GEONAMES_USERNAME. `quota_exhausted`: GeoNames reported the account's hourly, daily, or weekly credit limit spent, or this server's pacer for the account shed the call. `upstream_rejected_parameter`: GeoNames rejected a value the schema let through; the message carries its text. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page; absent on the last page.

notFound.description: Requested codes that match no GeoNames country; empty when every code matched.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, the offset is past the end, or more pages remain.

totalCount.description: Countries matching the filters, before paging.

truncated.description: True when more countries remain past this page.

title: GeoNames country facts
